recap: Two torches, two nights, one brutal stretch of island — welcome to "Sorting Hogs." Mike grabbed immunity and the reward, and he took Cristian, Maggie and Sharonda along for the ride, which is a nice way to spend an afternoon and a complicated way to spend a vote. Cristian picked up immunity of his own, so two necklaces were off the board when the whispers started. On Day 18, Maggie Nestor — a name that had been catching heat around camp for a while now — became the 11th person voted out and the fourth member of our jury. Then on Day 19, Carter Krull followed her down the path as the 12th person voted out and the fifth juror, idol or no idol. That's the game, folks: you can hold the advantage, win the reward, sit by the fire — and still hear your name read out loud.
bullets: Mike did it all this episode: immunity around the neck and a reward he shared with Cristian, Maggie and Sharonda.
Cristian keeps climbing — this time he took immunity and took himself off the menu entirely.
Maggie's name had been floating as a target for weeks, and on Day 18 it finally stuck.
Carter came into this one with an idol in his pocket and still became the fifth member of the jury on Day 19.
Two votes, two blindside-sized gut punches, and a jury that is suddenly getting very, very full.
draftImpact: Tim, you still lead at 63 after a +4 night, but it cost you Maggie — you're down to two castaways standing. Austin, +3 to 43, but Carter's torch is out and you're holding on with one. Tami, biggest night on the board, 48 to 54, three of five still breathing, with Rob not counting under the best-4 rule. Kylie, a quiet +2 to 35 with Cristian carrying you alone. Taylor, 31 and holding, with nobody left in the game. Tim leads — for now.
